content.text:
Profile names now keep their capitals, so "Ada Lovelace" displays as typed instead of "ada lovelace".

The cause was in `clean.js`. The shared `clean` helper lowercased everything, and `displayName` in `profile.js` uses it. I moved the lowercasing out of `clean` and into the two places that need it:

- `clean.js`: now only trims and squashes whitespace.
- `handle.js`: lowercases before building the handle, so "Ada Lovelace" still becomes `ada-lovelace`.
- `search.js`: compares lowercased names and queries, so search still ignores case.
- `test/profile.test.js`: added a regression test that checks capitals survive in display names.

I also ran a quick check of the handle and search code, which has no test: `makeHandle('Ada Lovelace')` returned `ada-lovelace`, and searching `ADA` found Ada Lovelace. Those outputs came from my own `node -e` run in this session.
